project.name: Daher End Maternity Admission
project.description: Narrow, Daher-owned OpenMRS module (ADR-030, Option D). Exposes exactly one operation: end the active canonical Daher Maternity Admission Visit by setting its stopDatetime. Never grants the browser session Edit Visits, Assign Beds, Edit Admission Locations, Manage Queue Entries, or Get Concepts -- the elevation exists only inside this one server-side operation. See DECISIONS.md ADR-030 and PROJECT_STATE.md BLOCKER-10 for the full design record.
